typography.strategy: Soft Utility pairing. Clean, readable, and highly accessible for medical contexts.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces ONLY. Crisp borders for separation.
visual_enhancers.controls: Minimum 60dp height for all touchable controls (buttons, inputs) to ensure maximal accessibility.

components.name: SettingsDoctorFields
components.description: Text input fields for 'Family/Personal Doctor Name' and 'Doctor Phone Number' located in the Settings screen. Must be at least 60dp high.

components.name: SettingsEmergencyNumber
components.description: Text input field in Settings for editable country emergency number. Defaults to '112'.

components.name: CallChoiceHealthSheet
components.description: A bottom sheet popup containing large accessible buttons to choose between calling Caretaker or Doctor. Must handle missing states by providing a 'Set up in Settings' link.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Mobile-first accessible flexbox layout. Vertical stacks for forms with generous spacing (min 24px between field groups). Forms should be easily scannable.

motion.strategy: Smooth slide-up transition for the HealthSheet popup. Micro-interactions on touchable elements (opacity reduction on press).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text passes WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1).
accessibility.touch_targets: All buttons and inputs MUST be at least 60dp (height: 60) for motor accessibility.
accessibility.test_ids: Mandatory data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., testID='settings-doctor-name-input', testID='call-doctor-button').

icons_and_media.strategy: Use lucide-react-native for all icons. Avoid AI emojis.

instructions_to_main_agent: Modify the Settings screen to include fields for 'Family/Personal Doctor Name' and 'Doctor Phone Number'.
Modify the Settings screen to include an editable 'Emergency Country Number' field that defaults to '112'.
Update the existing floating Call button to open a 'HealthSheet' (bottom sheet choice popup) instead of immediately calling.
In the HealthSheet, show choices for 'Call Caregiver' and 'Call Doctor'.
If either contact is missing, clearly show the missing contact state in the HealthSheet and provide a link that navigates to the Settings screen.
Ensure location is ONLY requested when the user taps 'Share my location' (no automatic location requests).
For the 'Travel SOS' feature mentioned in the problem statement: DO NOT BUILD IT. Simply document it as a planned feature in code comments if necessary.
Preserve MedicPal's existing accessible light-blue style and ensure all controls are 60dp minimum height.
All updated or new interactive elements MUST have a testID property.
Ensure all instructions are applied for .js files as the environment uses JS.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use flat solid colors for health apps (no glass).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
